title: Transect: Retaining Observability for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Evaluations
headline: Transect open-source tool for long-horizon LLM agent evaluation
summary: The UK AI Safety Institute has released Transect, an open-source package designed to maintain observability during open-ended, long-horizon frontier AI evaluations. Built on Inspect Scout, the tool helps evaluators classify agent behaviour, align events on a common timeline, and verify interpretations against underlying transcripts. The approach addresses the narrowing observability envelope caused by complex multi-agent networks and lengthy evaluation transcripts.
why_it_matters: Organisations conducting advanced AI evaluations can adopt this tool to enhance the reproducibility, transparency and auditability of complex multi-agent safety assessments.

quotes.text: Transect is an open source package built on Inspect Scout to help evaluators understand how a long agent run unfolded, identify behaviour worth investigating, and check interpretations against the transcript.

Transect's flexible, customisable transcript-analysis pipeline will enable evaluators to keep pace with longer, more complex, more frequent AI evaluations while supporting scientific rigour, transparency, and reproducibility.

dates_mentioned.what: Publication of the research blog post and paper regarding Transect.

classification.significance_reason: Provides a practical open-source assurance and evaluation methodology for complex multi-agent AI systems, though it is primarily a technical research release.
